Chat for five minutes. Walk away with a live website.

WebGenie Bot is the Telegram bot that turns an ordinary conversation into a fully hosted, mobile-ready, SEO-friendly website — no code, no designer, no back-and-forth emails.

Get My Website

A website built the way you'd explain your business to a friend

Most website builders hand you a blank template and a wall of settings, then leave you to figure out what "meta description" even means. WebGenie Bot skips all of that. You open Telegram, say hello, and answer a few plain questions about what you do, who you serve, and what makes your business worth a look. The bot listens like a person would, then quietly assembles the pages, the wording, and the technical bits behind the scenes — SEO tags, mobile sizing, hosting — while you're still typing.

It's built for the businesses that usually get skipped by web design altogether: the plumber who's been meaning to get a site up for a year, the tutor building a client list, the shop owner who doesn't have a spare afternoon a week to fight with a drag-and-drop editor. If your business is real and you can describe it in a sentence or two, WebGenie Bot can turn that into a page worth sending to a customer.

There's no separate design phase, no waiting for a draft to land in your inbox three days later. The conversation is the build process. You can change your mind mid-chat, ask for the tone to be friendlier or more formal, swap a service in or out, and the site updates to match — because you're not filling out a form once, you're talking it through until it's right.

Once it's live, the relationship doesn't end there. The same chat window that built your site is where you go to see who's actually visiting it, so you're never left guessing whether anyone's finding you.

Everything you need to go live, in one chat

No separate quotes for design, hosting, and maintenance — it's one conversation, and it covers the whole job.

Tell it about your business

Describe what you do in your own words, and the bot writes the pages for you — headlines, service descriptions, the lot — without you having to stare at a blinking cursor wondering where to start.

A live link the moment you're done

No separate hosting to arrange, no domain settings to untangle. As soon as the chat wraps up, your site is already live at a real, working address you can share right away.

Built to get found on Google

Search optimization isn't a paid add-on you have to remember to ask for — it's baked into every page the bot builds, so your site has a genuine shot at showing up when someone searches for what you do.

Looks right on every phone

Most people will meet your business on a phone screen, not a desktop. Every layout the bot produces is shaped to work cleanly on mobile from the first version, not patched afterward.

See who's visiting, right in the chat

Once your site's live, ask the bot how it's doing. Traffic analytics show up inside the same Telegram conversation, so checking your numbers is as easy as sending a message.

From hello to live link

1

Say hello

Open Telegram, start a chat with WebGenie Bot, and tell it what your business does — no forms, no sign-up flow, just a normal conversation.

2

Answer a few quick questions

The bot asks what it actually needs to know — your services, who you serve, the tone you want — and nothing more than that.

3

Watch it take shape

Your site is drafted right there in the chat. Don't like a section? Say so, and it's rewritten on the spot, no revision cycles or waiting on a designer.

4

Get your live link

Once you're happy, the site goes live — hosted, mobile-ready, and tagged for search — under five minutes after you first said hello.

5

Keep an eye on it

Come back to the same chat any time to check traffic, update wording, or add a new service — the bot remembers your site.

Questions people ask before they start

Do I need to know how to code?
No. The entire point of WebGenie Bot is that you never touch code, a template editor, or a settings panel. You describe your business in a chat and the bot handles everything technical.
How long does this actually take?
Most businesses can get a live link in under five minutes of chatting. How quickly you're done depends mostly on how much you want to describe — you're in control of the pace.
Will my site work properly on phones?
Yes. Every site the bot builds is optimized for mobile screens from the start, since that's where most of your visitors will actually land.
Can people actually find my site on Google?
Search optimization is built into every site automatically — there's no separate SEO package to buy or configure later.
What if I need to change something after it's live?
Just message the bot again and describe the change — a new service, updated wording, a different photo focus. There's no re-building from scratch.
Can I see how many people are visiting my site?
Yes. Ask the bot about your traffic and it will show you your site's visitor activity right inside the same Telegram chat you used to build it.

How to reach WebGenie Bot

There's no phone number to dial, no support ticket to file, and no contact form disappearing into a queue somewhere. WebGenie Bot lives entirely inside Telegram — open a chat with it, say hello, and it starts asking the right questions to get your site built right then and there.

If you're ready to see what your business looks like as a live website, there's nothing to schedule and nothing to prepare. Start the conversation whenever you have a few free minutes, coffee optional.

Your website is one conversation away

Say what your business does. WebGenie Bot handles the rest — design, hosting, search optimization, and a live link before your coffee goes cold.
